entity_classes: {"Algorithm": {"comment": "A complete parametric definition \u2014 the top-level container for the computational process. Maps to a Grasshopper definition file (the whole canvas). Contains Procedures. Example: '1_Algorithm' generating a Frame object.", "iri": "http://example.org/design-grammar/comp#Algorithm", "label": "Algorithm", "local_name": "dgc:Algorithm"}, "Interface": {"comment": "An inter-procedure connector \u2014 exposes data between Procedures. Bridge: Atoms can reference Parameters via dgc:attributeOf. Maps to a Grasshopper Component (a node on the canvas). Has Interfaces (I/O ports) and receives Parameters. Patterns can host other Patterns (nesting). Example: '11_Pat_DivideLine', '11_Pat_TopChord', '12_Pat_1 - Create footer bottom lines'.", "iri": "http://example.org/design-grammar/comp#Pattern", "label": "Pattern", "local_name": "dgc:Pattern"}, "Procedure": {"comment": "A grouped sequence of Patterns within an Algorithm \u2014 an organizational unit of computation.
